course_name_original: Atatürk İlkeleri ve İnkılap Tarihi II
course_name_en: Atatürk's Principles and History of Revolutions II

learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to list the revolutions that occurred after the Republic.
Distinguish issues such as the Sheikh Said Rebellion and the Izmir assassination attempt against the Republic.
Summarize the transition process to a multi-party system.

syllabus_topics: French Revolution and its effects on the Ottoman Empire
First and Second Constitutional Monarchy periods
World War I and the Ottoman Empire's entry into the war
Atatürk's personality and his arrival in Samsun
Period of congresses and the War of Independence
Causes and consequences of the war, and Ottoman entry into the war
Mudros Armistice and the occupation of Anatolia
Reasons for Atatürk's dispatch to Samsun
Armed phase of the National Struggle
Battles of İnönü, Sakarya and the Great Offensive
Mudanya Armistice and Turkish Political Life
